Rufflet

Normal Flying

Unova · Generation 5

Rufflet is a Normal/Flying-type Eaglet Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 10.5 kg. It evolves into Braviary. Its highest base stat is Attack (83), with a base stat total of 350.
